concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR-001 (and all FR-001 … FR-015) have no corresponding task in tasks.md; no task is tagged [FR-001] or otherwise linked to this requirement.
Success Criterion SC-001 (and all SC-001 … SC-009) are not covered by any task; there is no task tagged or described to produce the required measurable outcomes.
Tasks T041, T042, T043, T045, T046‑T055, T068‑T076 are orphaned – they do not reference any FR, SC, contract, data‑model entity, or quickstart step, constituting scope‑creep.
The contracts defined in the contracts/ directory (e.g., dataset.schema.yaml, model_output.schema.yaml) are not mentioned or linked by any task, leaving contract compliance unverified.
Key data‑model entities (AlloyComposition, PhaseBoundary, ModelMetrics, PowerAnalysisResult) have no associated tasks; the pipeline lacks explicit work items to generate or validate these entities.
The quickstart documentation is not referenced by any task, so the required step of documenting a runnable command is uncovered.
